rewbla.note: Marked by hand on the shipped files from 32 kHz spectrograms and 10 ms band-energy envelopes (src/audio/cues.ts). XC678807 is 45.2-62.0 s of the recording, cut and made game-ready with processClip; xeno-canto files it as a female, but its songs are a male's konk-la-ree (intro notes, a buzzy trill, terminal notes) and its single notes between them are checks. XC703912 keeps only its first song, the focal bird's: its second is a different song about 7 LUFS quieter, and its third runs past the clip's end. XC469000 is a run of chack notes, not song: it is retyped a call and has no cues.
